_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Arrastra/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, controller cell at [0,0,0]: the middle of the front (north) row at ground level, where the draw gate is. Batch, by hand: no chute, no load or output anchor and no pipe; nothing automated feeds it. The player tips the charge straight into the open pit over its low curb and pours a bucket of water a rock after it, and draws the ground charge out at the gate in the curb (drawCell, its north face); the axle comes in high at the back (powerCell). Model only: no block or renderer reads it yet (#732). build: the stages in order. cells: the boxes of the whole machine built (the frame and every stage), the turning parts' swept over the cycle. The only input is theta, the axle's angle. See the arrastra's README.

build._comment: Provisional (#733): the stages in the order they go on, each fitting its requires value once its materials are in; the frame (the head frame and the power shaft) is placed. The frame's recipe and each stage's items are open. The contents (charge, paste) are the batch's, not stages.
